summary: Ord. 2026-5 amends Land Development Ordinance 10.1(C) to add data centers to the uses expressly prohibited in all districts.
notes: First introduced 2026-05-12, reintroduced 2026-06-09, final adoption 4-0 on 2026-07-14 per minutes. The posted adoption notice says passed 2026-06-09 (appears to conflate with reintroduction); minutes used.

summary: Ord. 2026-05 defines data centers and makes them a prohibited use in the township zoning code.
notes: Planning Board forwarded solicitor draft 2026-03-10; committee adopted after public hearing 2026-05-05 (citizenportal AI meeting summary). Township site not checked.

summary: Ord. 2026-09 prohibits data centers and related facilities in all township zoning districts.
notes: Unanimous roll call 2026-06-10, no public comment (citizenportal AI meeting summary). Township site not checked.

summary: Ord. 26-01 amends Ch. 70 Land Development to confirm data centers are prohibited uses or structures in all zoning districts.
notes: Adopted unanimously on second reading; Planning Board Res. 09-2026 supported it. Date is the citizenportal meeting date (2026-03-05). Pass-1 saw only 2026 ords 26-07/26-08 on the homepage.

summary: Ord. 2026-11 would designate data centers a non-permitted use in all zones of the town.
notes: Introduced 2026-09-10; public hearing and final adoption on the 2026-10-08 council agenda (OCR of scanned agendas). Pinelands Alliance already lists Hackettstown as banned.

summary: Ord. 2026-3 adds a data center definition (120-5) and lists data centers among uses specifically prohibited in any zone (120-37).
notes: Codified history note: amended 6-3-2026 by Ord. No. 2026-3. Draft referred to Planning Board 2026-05-20 after a 30-50,000 sq ft data center inquiry for Lebanon Road. Read via eCode360.

summary: Ord. 2026-11 defines data centers and designates them a non-permitted use in all zones of the borough.
notes: Introduced 2026-04-14; adopted 4-0 (2 absent) after public hearing 2026-05-12 per minutes and adoption notice.

summary: Land use code (Ch. 230) now defines data centers using the county model-ordinance text that other towns pair with a non-permitted-use designation; listed as a ban by Pinelands Alliance.
notes: Definition 230-5{54} is codified (verbatim match to Alpha 2026-11 and Washington Borough 2026-04 bans). Disposition list shows 2026 Ch. 230 amendments 2026-02/04/05 (3-9), 2026-07 (5-11), 2026-08 (7-13); which one adds data centers, and the prohibition clause itself, not seen. Verify with clerk.

summary: Ord. 15-2026 defines data centers (285-9) and adds them to Uses prohibited in all districts (285-182C).
notes: eCode360 New Laws: adopted 2026-05-06. Distinct from Pinelands log Ord 2026-08 (Ch 275, adopted 2026-09-01), which belongs to Washington Twp, Burlington County (pass-1 row add-nj-washington-twp-2026). Pinelands Alliance lists Washington Twp under Gloucester.

summary: Ord. 26-17 codifies the prohibition of data centers (incl. crypto mining, AI and colocation facilities) in all zones; existing lawful data processing facilities may continue as nonconforming.
notes: eCode360 New Laws: adopted 2026-09-10. Separate municipality from Rockaway Township (pass-1 row add-nj-rockaway-township-2026). SAVRN listed Rockaway Borough as proposed.

summary: Proposed ordinance would define data centers as a distinct use excluded from warehouse, office, storage, utility and similar categories, so they are not permitted anywhere.
notes: Introduced unanimously at a September 2026 council meeting (scheduled 2026-09-08; article 2026-09-21); second reading date and ordinance number not found. Mechanism is exclusion from all listed use categories rather than an explicit prohibited-use list.

summary: Ord. 2026-06 defines data centers and adds them to the uses prohibited in all zoning districts (123-4).
notes: eCode360 New Laws: adopted 2026-03-18. Recitals cite the Highlands RMP and rural master plan; prohibition chosen over conditional regulation. Separate from Washington Borough (Warren, Ord 2026-04).

summary: Ord. 3-2026 defines data centers (700-5) and adds all data centers and associated uses to the prohibited uses list (700-54) in all zones.
notes: eCode360 New Laws: adopted 2026-05-18. Pass-1 treated a Gloucester-county Greenwich citizenportal path as a mislabel of Warren County Greenwich Ord 107-2026; both townships have adopted bans.

summary: Ord. 2026-15 adds 100-20.2: data centers are a prohibited use, as principal or accessory use, in all zoning districts.
notes: Codified history: Added 7-21-2026 by Ord. No. 2026-15. Supersedes the conditional-use approach of Ord 2026-06 (introduced 2026-03-03) that pass-1 rejected.

summary: Ord. O-7-2026 adds data centers (incl. internet/cloud data centers and functional equivalents) to the uses prohibited in all districts (96-82).
notes: Codified history: 96-82 amended 4-21-2026 by Ord. No. O-7-2026. Not on Pinelands Alliance, Patch or SAVRN lists.

summary: Ord. 26-18 adds 17-9 prohibiting data centers (server farms, cloud, colocation, high-density computing) in all zones; existing lawful data centers become nonconforming.
notes: eCode360 New Laws: adopted 2026-09-16. Expansion or intensification of existing data centers prohibited unless authorized by council. Parts of Carlstadt lie in the Meadowlands district (NJSEA zoning), which a borough ordinance may not reach.

summary: Ord. 2026-645 amends Ch. 145 to prohibit data centers in every zoning district as principal, conditional, accessory, temporary or interim use.
notes: eCode360 New Laws: adopted 2026-08-20. Also states a data center is not a warehouse, office or similar permitted use.

summary: Ord. 26-15 defines data centers and adds them to prohibited uses (35-4-1.3); also defines warehouses to exclude data centers.
notes: Ordinance header: introduced 2026-08-19, adopted 2026-09-16.

summary: Ord. 2026-06 removes data centers as a permitted use from the TBI-1 and TBI-2 zones (the only zones allowing them) and adds a micro/mini data center (AI node) definition.
notes: Ordinance footer: introduced 2026-07-14, hearing and adoption 2026-08-11 (eCode360 New Laws lists 2026-08-08). Ban works by removing the only permitted-use listing; recitals state intent to prohibit data centers.

summary: Ord. 2026-007 adds a data center definition (115-4) and lists data centers as a prohibited use in all zoning districts (115-19).
